```python
import pandas as pd
import narwhals as nw

pdf = pd.DataFrame({"spend": [1500, 200, 999, 1000]})
df = nw.from_native(pdf, eager_only=True)

df = df.with_columns(
    nw.when(nw.col("spend") >= 1000)
    .then(nw.lit("gold"))
    .otherwise(nw.lit("standard"))
    .alias("tier")
)

print(df.to_native())
```
